title: 01_shopeasy_terms
summary: ShopEasy’s terms say the company can change the rules whenever it wants and you automatically agree by keeping the service. Your subscription will keep renewing each month unless you cancel within 14 days after renewal, and you can only get refunds for unopened items within 30 days. If you have a problem you must go to private arbitration and you can’t join a class‑action lawsuit. The company can share your data with advertisers and can close your account without warning.
keyPoints: The company can change the terms at any time without notice.
Your subscription renews automatically each month; cancel within 14 days after renewal to stop payments.
Refunds are only given for unopened digital goods and only if you ask within 30 days.
Disputes must be resolved through individual binding arbitration, not a class-action lawsuit.
Your account can be suspended or terminated without prior notice, and your data may be shared with advertising partners.

risks.clauseQuote: We may change these terms at any time without notice, and continued use means you accept the new terms.
risks.explanation: The company can rewrite the rules whenever it wants and you automatically agree just by keeping using the site.

risks.clauseQuote: Your subscription renews automatically every month until you cancel.
risks.explanation: If you forget to cancel, they will keep charging you each month.

risks.clauseQuote: Cancellations must be submitted through our support form within 14 days of renewal.
risks.explanation: You have to act quickly after renewal or you’ll keep paying.

risks.clauseQuote: Any dispute shall be resolved by binding arbitration on an individual basis, and you waive the right to participate in a class action lawsuit.
risks.explanation: You can’t sue the company together with other users; you must settle any problem in private arbitration.

risks.clauseQuote: ShopEasy's total liability for any claim arising out of the service is limited to the amount you paid in the 12 months before the claim.
risks.explanation: If something goes wrong, the most money you can get back is what you already spent in the past year.

risks.clauseQuote: We may share your account details with advertising partners and analytics vendors for targeted advertising purposes.
risks.explanation: Your personal info could be given to ad companies that will use it to show you ads.

risks.clauseQuote: Refunds are issued only within 30 days of purchase and only for unopened digital goods.
risks.explanation: You can only get money back if you ask within a month and the digital item hasn’t been opened.

risks.clauseQuote: ShopEasy may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, at our sole discretion and without prior notice.
risks.explanation: The company can lock or delete your account whenever it wants, even without warning.

disclaimer: This is an automated plain-language summary, not legal advice. Check the original document for anything that matters to you.
